entries.title: First pull: 16 houses fit
entries.lede: First data pull for the Prescott house hunt. I checked 12 listing sources and found 16 whole-house rentals with 5+ bedrooms or 4 bedrooms plus a den/office/loft. The strongest fit right now is 1478 Varsity Dr, Prescott (5 BR, $2,900, about 11 min to campus). A separate browser pass of Apartments.com, Zumper, HotPads, Trulia (sites that block automated fetching) added 4 more matches and 6 borderline houses (4 bedrooms plus a family room or casita, listed separately, not counted).
